name: Kids Junction Summer Camp
description_short: A summer day camp at Kids Junction in Barrington, RI for ages 3 to 12, open 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. with the program starting at 8:45. Weekly themes, swim lessons, cooking, daily sports, arts and crafts, theater, and science and nature, plus weekly field trips (extra fee) for children entering grade 1 and up.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim lessons are listed as a camp highlight. The page does not say where swimming takes place or what the swim staffing is.
